results.title: Peak Form
results.overview: After the sudden loss of a family member, Dan becomes fixated on improving his health, but online “experts” peddling wellness and life advice lead him down a dark and dangerous path.

results.title: Wham! 10 Days in China
results.overview: In 1985, WHAM! made history as the first Western pop act to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou were a cultural milestone – East meets West, music meets politics. Now, newly restored footage reveals the untold story of the iconic tour that helped launch WHAM! to global superstardom.

results.title: The Calling Witch
results.overview: A brother and sister are terrorized by what seems to be their late-author mother's most sinister literary creation -– The Calling Witch.

results.title: Bad Day at the Office
results.overview: A man with amnesia wakes up in a wrecked hotel room next to a corpse, triggering a dangerous conspiracy. He and a maid try to recover his memories and evade the police to uncover the mystery and survive those pursuing them.

results.title: Dead Eyes
results.overview: After the death of his sister, Sean and his friends venture into a remote forest to search for his missing father, only to uncover his dark secrets, where grief has become a bridge between the living and the dead.

results.title: Dreamland
results.overview: Ever since his moth­er died in a fire, Ter­rence has seclud­ed him­self in an emo­tion­less world.  He goes through his dai­ly teenag­er life apa­thet­i­cal­ly… with one excep­tion! The sim­ple sight of a flame plunges him into a world of fear, an awak­en ver­sion of his night­mares – for, every time he falls asleep, he help­less­ly relieves the trag­ic event, thus rekin­dling his pyro­pho­bia. Until that one night he can’t bear it any­more and stops run­ning away from the dev­il­ish flames. Lit­tle does he know that, by doing so, he over­came his great­est fear and became a Trav­el­er: a very spe­cial kind of Dream­er, able to explore Dream­land, the dimen­sion born from mankind’s dreams… and nightmares!

results.title: NJPW Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 - Day 8
results.original_title: NJPW Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 - Day 8
results.overview: The eighth and final night of Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 took place on May 1, 2026, at Aira City Sports Park Gymnasium in Aira, Kagoshima, Japan.

results.title: Ballroom
results.overview: A devastating accident forces aspiring dancer Violet to relearn life in a wheelchair. Through dance and an unexpected bond, she discovers that dreams don't disappear - they transform.

results.title: Micronations
results.overview: From backyard kingdoms to full-blown diplomatic summits, the world's self-declared kings, queens and emperors invite you in. A whimsical and surprisingly timely documentary about borders, identity and the human need to belong.

results.title: Mension House Mallesh
results.overview: In a quiet village where gossip spreads faster than the wind, a swaggering young man becomes the talk of the town after his wedding night sparks unexpected rumours. What follows is a hilarious chain of misunderstandings, ego clashes, and small-town chaos. Mension House Mallesh is a lively rural entertainer packed with satire and nonstop laughter.

results.title: Sleep No More
results.overview: As two sisters clash over whether their mother’s sudden death at a wig factory was suicide or demonic possession, their brother's supernatural body-regenerative gift attracts a wandering ghost searching for a human host.

results.title: Niu Lai
results.overview: The naive calf Niu Lai loves exploring the grasslands, but struggles to live up to his family’s expectations as future leader of the herd. With migration fast approaching, Niu Lai finds unlikely allies on his journey to learn the meaning of courage as they prepare for a dangerous trek across the desert.

results.title: Igniting the Flame: The Making of “Avatar: Fire and Ash”
results.original_title: Igniting the Flame: The Making of “Avatar: Fire and Ash”
results.overview: A series of featurettes exploring how the filmmakers made “Avatar: Fire and Ash”.

results.title: Minnesota Mao
results.overview: A cutting look at the strange connections between Governor Tim Walz—aka "Minnesota Mao"—and Chairman Mao Zedong, the former dictator of the Chinese Communist Party, based on interviews, archival footage, and news and social media.

results.title: Yaga
results.overview: In this psychological descent into ancient witchcraft, power, and seduction, two investigators unlock dark secrets after questioning a mysterious professor about a missing student.

results.title: The Doll Ghawiah
results.overview: It all began with an accident on Babakan Siliwangi Road. Nala encountered a mysterious little girl and her doll in the Babakan Siliwangi forest. The doll’s name was Ghawiah, which means “lost.” Ever since that accident, many strange occurrences have begun to haunt the local residents.

results.title: Le Cid
results.overview: A stage performance of the tragicomedy broadcasted live in theaters.

results.title: No Such Thing as a Vampire
results.original_title: No Such Thing as a Vampire
results.overview: Alexis, the wife of Dr. Cheria, mysteriously falls ill, it's believed by the villagers that she is a victim of a vampire. One night, she awakes screaming with blood running from two marks down her neck.

results.title: Risa and the Wind Phone
results.original_title: Risa y la cabina del viento
results.overview: Risa, after her father's death, discovers she has the ability to communicate with him from beyond the grave. As she explores this supernatural connection, she faces emotional challenges and family secrets that will test her faith in what she thought was possible.
